_readme: CoRun.ai agency page content. Edit text here only; no code changes needed. Rules: always write CoRun.ai; no pricing, no metrics, no customer names, no promises about premiums. HubSpot IDs and links live in the CONFIG block at the top of index.html, not here.

how.title: Tell us about your agency
how.text: Answer a few quick questions with the onboarding assistant. It takes about a minute.

how.title: Talk to the CoRun.ai team
how.text: A short conversation about your fleet clients and how renewal preparation works in CoRun.ai.

how.title: Work with your fleet clients
how.text: Each fleet decides what to share. Your agency sees only the information the fleet approves.

timeline.text: Confirm the renewal date, review available records, identify gaps and assign owners.
Resolve missing information and document completed corrective actions.
Assemble the available package for fleet review and approval before it is shared with you.
Track follow-up requests and material changes. Your agency manages the submission and placement.

faq.q: Does CoRun.ai replace the insurance agent?
faq.a: No. Your agency leads insurance advice, market selection and placement. CoRun.ai supports the information and follow-up behind those decisions.
Only the information each fleet client has authorized and approved.

faq.q: Will CoRun.ai lower my clients' premiums?
faq.a: Insurers decide pricing. CoRun.ai helps fleets organize records and follow through on risk-related actions before renewal. Savings are not guaranteed.

shared.privacyLine: By submitting, you agree to be contacted by the CoRun.ai team about CoRun.ai.
shared.signoff: Driven by intelligence. Built around people.

renewal.label: Renewal prep
renewal.headline: Help your fleet clients walk into renewal prepared.
renewal.subhead: CoRun.ai helps your trucking clients start renewal preparation 90 days ahead, so records, owners and open items are organized well before the deadline.

benefits.title: Start renewal conversations earlier
benefits.text: Use the 90/60/30-day process to find gaps, coordinate follow-up and give your team more time to prepare the submission.

benefits.title: Less time chasing paperwork
benefits.text: Track missing records, responsible owners and preparation status in one authorized workspace.

benefits.title: A clearer story for underwriters
benefits.text: Bring together fleet-approved records, relevant safety information and documented corrective actions.

renewal.bandTitle: Give your fleet clients a clearer path to renewal.

assistant.greeting: Hi, I'm Violette. I'll help you get started with renewal preparation for your fleet clients. It takes about a minute.
assistant.formPrompt: Tell me a little about your agency and I'll pass it to the CoRun.ai team.

between-renewals.label: Between renewals
between-renewals.eyebrow: FOR INSURANCE AGENTS · YEAR-ROUND CLIENT SUPPORT
between-renewals.headline: Give your fleet clients more value between renewals.
between-renewals.subhead: CoRun.ai connects year-round fleet follow-up with renewal preparation, so your client conversations are useful all year, not only at renewal time.

benefits.title: More reasons to stay in touch
benefits.text: Use documented progress and open priorities to make client conversations useful between renewals.

benefits.title: Progress your clients can see
benefits.text: Fleet clients keep an organized record of the actions they took, supported by available records and fleet-approved summaries.

benefits.title: A practical service to offer
benefits.text: Connect everyday fleet management with renewal preparation, and give clients a visible reason to value your agency's ongoing service.

between-renewals.bandTitle: Make every client conversation more useful.

assistant.greeting: Hi, I'm Violette. I'll help you see how CoRun.ai supports your fleet clients between renewals. It takes about a minute.
assistant.formPrompt: A few quick questions, then the CoRun.ai team will follow up.

partner.label: Become a partner
partner.headline: Stronger fleet clients. Better-prepared renewals.
partner.subhead: Bring CoRun.ai to your trucking clients. Your agency keeps its advisory role, and each fleet stays in control of what it shares.

benefits.title: Partner inquiry
benefits.text: Tell us about your agency and your trucking clients. The onboarding assistant collects the basics.

benefits.title: Program review
benefits.text: The CoRun.ai team talks with you about how renewal preparation works for your clients.

benefits.title: Agency onboarding
benefits.text: Set up your agency workspace. Referral attribution never grants access to a fleet's data.

partner.bandTitle: You bring the fleet. We bring the tech.

assistant.greeting: Hi, I'm Violette. I'll walk you through the first step of becoming a CoRun.ai agency partner.
assistant.formPrompt: Answer a few questions and I'll start your partner inquiry.

assistantSteps.ask: First, what's your role at the agency?
How many trucking clients does your agency work with?
Optional: add one client's USDOT number. In agency onboarding you can look up public FMCSA records for your book.
Last step: how should the CoRun.ai team reach you?

assistantDone.title: Thanks! Your details are with the CoRun.ai team.
assistantDone.text: The team will reach out to set up a conversation. You can also continue to agency onboarding now.
